passives.name: Support Quest
passives.effects: Earn 400 through Shared Riches and this item's gold generation stat to automatically upgrade to Runic Compass, gaining the Ward active with 3 wards in stock.

passives.name: Shared Riches
passives.effects:
Grants a Shared Riches charge every 20 seconds, up to 3 charges. When an allied champion is within 1050 units of you, consume a charge in the following ways:
• Kill a minion by any means, granting you 15 and the nearest allied champion kill gold. Damaging a minion below (50% /30%) of its maximum health with a basic attack will execute it, if any charges are available.
• Damage an enemy champion or structure with a basic attack or ability, granting you (22 /20). A charge may be consumed this way only once per attack or ability.
Receives diminishing gold from excessive minion kills.
